intro: This tense confrontation is a pivotal step in unraveling the mystery of the missing diplomat. Following a trail through Stormwind's underbelly, an investigator corners Dashel Stonefist in Old Town to force answers out of the stubborn ruffian.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yeah, you're obviously not the smartest adventurer to come into Stormwind, but you're about to be one of the dumbest to never leave.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I didn't mean anything by the comment 'bout you being a stupid adventurer. We're friends, right? No hard feelings?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, you came to me for a reason. What is it you need?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
